meta.title: Mumbai Suburban Rail Network — stations, codes, distances, graph and fare rules
changes_from_v1: Central line chainage re-anchored so Badlapur–CSMT = 68 km, matching a real RailOne season ticket.
Thane now 33.7 and Kalyan 53.9 (the map prints 33 and 53 — it rounds down).
Added is_routing_point, cidco_surcharge, edges[], fare_rules and ticket validity rules.
v3.3: station display names aligned with the UTS station list (utsqrcode.co.in/state/maharashtra); every previous name kept as an alias so search still matches it.
caveats: The map is 'not to scale' and its per-hop numbers are whole-km rounded; they do not sum to the terminus totals.
Fare figures are deliberately NULL. Populate them from the WR/CR suburban fare tables before shipping.
Station codes for smaller Harbour/Trans-Harbour/Uran stations are unverified.
Metro and Monorail use separate tariffs and have no IR station codes.
minutes_from_origin are indicative slow-local running times off the map, not a timetable. Fast locals are materially quicker.

map_km_from_origin sometimes disagrees with km_from_origin. Badlapur is the known case: map says 67, a real season ticket says 68. Charge on km_from_origin; display map_km only if you want parity with m-Indicator.
The map marks Gavan-Uran under construction. That section may since have opened - verify before hiding those stations.
changes_from_v2: Added minutes_from_origin (and minutes_from_thane for Navi Mumbai) from the map's time boxes.
Added map_km_from_origin so you can display the map's own figure next to our chainage.
Added aliases[] for every station — map spelling, platform-board spelling and common short forms.
Added status_on_map for the Nerul-Uran branch, which the map marks under construction past Kharkopar.
Added verified 6-10 km single second-class fare (Rs.5), return validity rule, passenger-count formula and ticket display rules — all from a real Airoli-Thane return ticket.
changes_from_v3: Populated single_second and single_first across ~1–124 km from mumbailifeline.com's fare calculator (a real, queryable API, not a hand-typed guess) — cross-checked against the one photographed real ticket we already had, which it matches exactly (6–10km → Rs.5).

Captured AC Local fares from the same source in single_ac_unverified_for_future_use, but did NOT wire AC into the engine or UI as a priced class — that would need mumbai-rail.js's quote() and the search form's Class select to change too, left for a deliberate follow-up.
Season-pass (MST/QST/HST/YST) figures are untouched — that site only calculates single-journey fares, so they remain mostly null beyond the one verified real season ticket.
Bands past ~124 km (no line on this network reaches that far in one hop) are left null rather than extrapolated from shorter bands.

fare_rules.principle: Fare is a function of the chargeable distance slab, class and ticket type — NOT of the number of stops or interchanges.
fare_rules.chargeable_distance: Shortest permitted route distance between origin and destination, rounded up into the slab.
fare_rules.rounding: Suburban second class uses its own rounding rule; other classes round up to the nearest ₹5.

fare_rules.slab_note: single_second and single_first are now populated for most of the network (1–130 km) from mumbailifeline.com's fare calculator API, cross-checked against the one photographed RailOne ticket we hold (6–10km, matches exactly). That site itself labels its numbers as approximate, so treat these as good-quality estimates, not official confirmed fares — replace with a real WR/CR published table if one turns up. mst_second/mst_first (season passes) are NOT covered by that site (it only calculates single-journey fares) and remain mostly null, aside from the one verified real season ticket. Bands beyond ~124 km have no real same-line station pair on any line to source from (no line reaches that far) and are left null rather than extrapolated.

single.validity: Same day. Journey must commence within the permitted window of issue.

return.note: No discount on suburban return; it is simply twice the single fare.
return.validity: Until 23:59 of the day AFTER the booking date.
return.ticket_text: Valid for one ret. jrny. till midnight of {valid_till_date}

season_monthly.derivation: Historically 15 × second-class single fare, but ship the published MST table rather than computing it.

concessions.child_5_to_12: Half adult fare, subject to the class minimum.
concessions.senior_student_handicapped: Separate concession season tickets exist — model as a discount code, verify percentages.

cidco.note: Levied on top of the base fare; amount varies — source it, do not guess.

fare_rules.unverified_warning: Season-pass (mst_second/mst_first) figures are still almost entirely unsourced beyond the one verified 66–70km MST anchor — do not ship those without a real source. Single-journey figures are now sourced from a third-party calculator (see slab_note) rather than fabricated, but that site's own disclaimer calls them approximate — verify against an official table before treating them as exact.

ticket_categories.journey: Single or return, printed as 'Journey Ticket'.

passengers.adults: 1..N, each charged the full slab fare.
passengers.children: Age 5-12, charged half the adult fare subject to the class minimum. Under 5 travel free and are not counted.
passengers.total_formula: total = adults * fare + children * max(fare/2, class_minimum)

display_rules.via_when_direct: Print '------' when the journey needs no routing points.
